column2: #363 [W-19] Sandbox 显式选择与缺依赖提示 two-axis independent review (implementer=self, reviewed diff against playbook checklist); Correctness APPROVE P0-P4=0: default path byte-identical (backend=None→deployment default "local"; Session.start without sandbox_backend writes no audit field; web request without field → None), fail-closed verified by test (docker unavailable → SandboxUnavailableError, registry.exists False, zero side effects; build_runtime raises before Session.start so no session/started is written), unknown backend → 422 at request validator (registry ValueError is second line of defense), empty-string backend rejected loudly not defaulted, probe is side-effect-free (images.get never pulls; all docker SDK exceptions caught → unavailable, never crash), 409 detail JSON-safe (reason/details are strings; SDK exc text in reason is local paths only, no secrets), re-probe in 409 handler hits same fast path as the probe that just failed (no hang risk); Spec APPROVE: aligns with Vision §3 #14 (sandbox selection is Runtime boundary) and #20 (docker probe failure cannot take down Core/local), 05_SANDBOX_CODING_TOOLS.md backend model extended per-session not contradicted, ticket #363 "backend 先行" scope honored (no frontend changes); mature-product lineage documented in ~/workspace/issue-363-study/REPORT.md (DSH SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE fail-closed + sandbox/mode audit event; Claude Code failIfUnavailable naming; Cline grey-out-not-hide; Pi hard-error-with-remediation). Findings fixed during review: (1) sandbox_backend param initially added to build_runtime signature while use site is in _build_tooling → moved param + pass-through (caught by ruff F821); (2) unknown backend name had no web-layer mapping → added field_validator → 422 (test added); (3) ruff S110/I001/RUF022/RUF100 fixed. Test gaps noted (P3, non-blocking): no web-client test for 409 mapping (handler is 15-line dict construction; registry-level fail-closed is tested); no service.create_and_launch pass-through test (straight kwarg plumbing). Tests: tests/sandbox/test_capabilities.py 14/14 green; tests/sandbox/ 136 pass (1 pre-existing flake test_timeout_returns_negative_exit_code fails on clean tree too); tests/test_assembly*.py 16/16; tests/session/test_service.py 44/44; ruff clean.
